Tyler Maine, a division of Tyler Technologies, delivers digital government solutions and payments for public sector entities. The Application Developer develops, migrates, maintains, and supports web applications for Maine State Government, including eGovernment and eCommerce applications, while collaborating with project managers, systems administrators, security analysts, and other developers.

Responsibilities
The developer will be technically well-rounded, including but not limited to writing code, understanding basic networking, understanding web application architecture and devops functions. The successful candidate will:
Write code for new and existing applications
Provide technical expertise within an assigned business unit in the analysis, design, and development of business applications
Bring a well-rounded and highly knowledgeable technical background in development of web/mobile applications, services & solutions
Deliver quality solutions and support those solutions through the SDLC change process and into production
Drive the development of new small- to large-scale projects while simultaneously supporting our existing service catalog
Provide technical consulting support on projects and system issues
Evaluate application software packages and make recommendations to management
Participate in business and IT project estimation activities

Required
Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related discipline or equivalent work experience
1+ years' professional experience, preferably in business, government, or eCommerce industries
Preferred
Proficient in Perl (preferred) and/or PHP, and development for Linux based web server environments
Familiarity with Java preferred
Experience with relational databases and SQL for implementing database-driven, web-based applications
Command line knowledge of Linux-based operating systems such as CentOS and Amazon Linux
Strong organizational and prioritization skills
Excellent communication skills, including good written and verbal abilities
Desire to work in fast-paced entrepreneurial environment to ensure that applications meet or exceed specifications in a 3-tier, scalable, and secure environment
Self-motivated, creative, and strong sense of accountability
Commitment to usability, accessibility, security, and privacy standards as applicable in digital government
Ability to work well with others
